summary: First MVP test of Miracurl Salon Management. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering auth (login/wrong-pwd/me/register), customers/services/staff/products CRUD, appointments flow, invoice creation with stat updates, and dashboard/sales reports. Frontend: All 11 review items pass — login + wrong-password error, dashboard with KPIs & charts, customer add/search/edit, services/staff/inventory pages with seed data + low-stock banner, POS end-to-end checkout produced Invoice INV-202606-0002 (₹708 incl. 18% tax) with receipt modal, logout redirects to /login, unauthed /dashboard redirects to /login. data-testid coverage is solid (nav-*, login-*, add-customer-button, pos-tab-*, pos-customer-select, pos-item-*, pos-generate-invoice-btn, logout-btn, etc.).

minor.issue: Lockout uses (host:email) identifier — rec.locked_until is updated on every failed attempt, so an attacker keeps lockout window rolling. Not a blocker for MVP.

Update payload (CustomerIn) overwrites loyalty_points/total_spent/visits to zero via $set of full model_dump if those fields were not in the input — but CustomerIn does not contain those fields so MongoDB $set only writes provided keys (model_dump excludes nothing). Risk: editing a customer would not clobber stats only because CustomerIn does NOT include them. Verified OK in tests.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. A <span> (likely an icon/badge) is rendered inside an <option> element which is invalid HTML.

issues: Dark luxury gold theme renders nicely; KPIs, trend chart and low-stock alerts visible. No contrast issues observed in primary flows.

action_items: (Optional / LOW) Remove <span> inside <option> in select dropdowns (Appointments New Booking modal / POS customer & stylist selects) to silence React hydration warning.
(Optional) Make login lockout NOT reset locked_until on every failed attempt after the lock has begun; otherwise the lock keeps rolling forward.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handler.

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' in .env, but allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] is rejected by browsers and triggers CORS errors. For local preview it works because credentials are also sent via Bearer header. For prod, configure explicit origins.

Login route uses request.client.host inside JWT_SECRET-dependent block; rate-limit identifier may be a Kubernetes ingress IP (all users share lockout). Consider using only email key with separate IP key.
Frontend stores access_token in localStorage AND backend sets httpOnly cookies — duplication. If localStorage path is kept, XSS risk increases. Prefer cookie-only.
All endpoints require auth via get_current_user but there is NO role check anywhere — any authenticated user can DELETE customers/staff/services/products. Add role-based gating.
Invoice creation does not check product stock availability before decrementing — can go negative.
_clean only pops _id but motor returns inserted docs without _id mutation; insert_one mutates the dict to inject _id which is correctly stripped. OK.
test_credentials: admin@miracurl.com / Miracurl@123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, seeded on backend startup, confirmed working).
seed_data_creation: Seed data is created automatically on backend startup: 10 services, 4 staff, 6 products (2 are low-stock to trigger banner), 5 customers. Tests created/deleted temporary TEST_* records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login submit button uses data-testid='login-submit-btn' (not '-button'). Customer save uses 'customer-save-btn'. POS items use 'pos-item-<id>'. Sidebar uses 'nav-<page>'. Logout is 'logout-btn'. Invoice generation works end-to-end and persists to /api/invoices. After POS checkout a receipt modal opens with INV-YYYYMM-#### number; close it before navigating away else other clicks are intercepted by the overlay.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking bugs found. The only visible runtime warning is a React hydration warning caused by <span> inside <option> in some <select> dropdowns. Fix: move icon outside the <option> or remove it (HTML spec disallows phrasing content inside <option>).
